020import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
021import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
022
023/**
024 * PhasedEvent represents an event that has different phases, and is called during different
025 * lifecycles.
026 *
027 * @author creatorfromhell
028 * @see Phase
029 * @since 6.2.0.9
030 */
031public abstract class PhasedEvent extends AbstractQSEvent implements QSCancellable {
032
033  protected final Phase phase;
034
035  //Cancellable variables.
036  protected Component cancelReason = null;
037  protected boolean cancelled = false;
038  protected boolean canCancel = true;
039
040  public PhasedEvent() {
041
042    this.phase = Phase.MAIN;
043  }
044
045  public PhasedEvent(final boolean async) {
046
047    super(async);
048
049    this.phase = Phase.MAIN;
050  }
051
052  public PhasedEvent(final Phase phase) {
053
054    this.phase = phase;
055  }
056
057  public PhasedEvent(final Phase phase, final boolean async) {
058
059    super(async);
060
061    this.phase = phase;
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Creates a new instance of PhasedEvent with the specified newPhase.
066   *
067   * @param newPhase The new Phase for the cloned PhasedEvent
068   *
069   * @return A new instance of PhasedEvent with the specified newPhase
070   */
071  public abstract PhasedEvent clone(final Phase newPhase);
072
073  public Phase phase() {
074
075    return phase;
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * Checks if the given phase is equal to the current phase of this PhasedEvent.
080   *
081   * @param phase The phase to compare with the current phase
082   *
083   * @return true if the given phase is equal to the current phase, false otherwise
084   */
085  public boolean isPhase(final Phase phase) {
086
087    return this.phase == phase;
088  }
089
090  @Override
091  public @Nullable Component getCancelReason() {
092
093    return cancelReason;
094  }
095
096  @Override
097  public void setCancelled(final boolean cancel, @Nullable final Component reason) throws IllegalStateException {
098
099    if(!phase().cancellable()) {
100
101      throw new IllegalStateException("Attempted to cancel a PhasedEvent that has a Phase, which isn't cancellable. " + phase.name());
102    }
103
104    this.cancelled = cancel;
105    this.cancelReason = reason;
106  }
107
108  @Override
109  public boolean isCancelled() {
110
111    return this.cancelled && phase.cancellable() && canCancel;
112  }
113
114}
